model.name: In-room chat works + tapping the room title opens room settings (@390)
model.description: TWO in-room fixes, each pinned @390 in-room. (1) IN-ROOM CHAT WORKS - a REAL regression: the in-room chat sends AND receives messages again. Architect root: R31.9 observePosition + R31.4 drawer-lifecycle changes hit the UN-GATED in-room chat drawer (RoomView uses the shared rb-detail-drawer as chatPanel per R30.20); the drawer refactor broke the chat panel mount/render. FIX = room-chat OPT-OUT (the in-room chat drawer opts out of the observePosition/detail-container lifecycle that broke it), preserving the R31.4/R31.9 drawer wins (positioning!=function, shared behavior). (2) ROOM SETTINGS OPEN FROM THE HEADER - a REAL regression (tester @390 real-device root 141d27f7b): an EMPTY rb-update-banner (fixed, z2000, pointer-events:auto) OVERLAYS the room header and intercepts taps on BOTH the room title AND the pencil edit button, so settings are unreachable (why Tron said 'don't open anymore' - the pencil that worked is now BLOCKED by the invisible banner). FIX = the empty banner does NOT capture pointer events / does not overlay the header safe-area; the title-tap affordance stays (already wired+correct). NOTE: an earlier architect STATIC read framed #2 as an add-affordance (title never had a handler); the tester's @390 REAL-DEVICE measurement SUPERSEDES it - the true root is the banner overlay, so #2 IS a regression. [[device-qa-regression-means-missing-ac]] + suspect-the-instrument (static read missed the runtime overlay). Feature-fix route: architect diagnosed -> expert building both -> tester gates @390 IN-ROOM. These slipped because the R31.4/R31.9 drawer gate never covered the IN-ROOM flow (missing-AC). ★ DEVICE-QA RE-OPEN (Tron 2026-07-27, served v0.7.143): #2 is DEEPER than the banner - even after the banner fix, tapping the room title does NOT open room properties on Tron's REAL @390 WebKit. The prior QA-Review GREEN (v0.7.141) was a FALSE-GREEN (gated in Chromium emulation/logic, not real WebKit). LAYER (b) added: the title-tap HANDLER must actually FIRE + open the room PROPERTIES/SETTINGS (S19 config modal) on real @390 WebKit, NOT gated out of the in-room state (rb-header.ts:50 gated on editable/show-edit/isHost via RoomView.ts:165 - architect confirms condition + host-only-vs-all + what 'room properties' resolves to). My own earlier 'title-tap already wired+correct' assumption was REFUTED by the device. T31.12 QA-Review -> In-Progress. Third framing (add-affordance -> banner-overlay -> handler-gated/false-green-emulation); each corrected by MEASUREMENT (static read -> real-device -> real-WebKit). Gate MUST be real @390 WebKit not emulation.

An earlier architect static read mis-framed #2 as add-affordance; the real-device root supersedes.] + TRON RULED 2026-07-27 (title->properties): title-tap opens the EXISTING config/settings modal (openRoomEditor, NO new view) for ALL in-room members (not host-only); non-host READ-ONLY, host EDITABLE; must fire on REAL @390 WebKit (the prior GREEN was a Chromium-emulation false-green).

acceptanceCriteria.text: @390 IN-ROOM: the chat WORKS again - the user can SEND a message and RECEIVE messages in-room. REAL REGRESSION (worked pre-R31.4/R31.9): the R31.9 observePosition + R31.4 drawer-lifecycle changes hit the un-gated in-room chat drawer (RoomView chatPanel on the shared rb-detail-drawer, R30.20), breaking the chat panel mount/render. Fix = room-chat OPT-OUT of the observePosition/detail-container lifecycle; the R31.4/R31.9 drawer wins (Server Manager / trace) MUST still hold (positioning!=function).

@390 IN-ROOM on REAL WebKit (Tron device, NOT Chromium emulation/logic): tapping the room TITLE OPENS the room PROPERTIES/SETTINGS modal. TWO layers, BOTH must hold: (a) the empty rb-update-banner must NOT overlay/intercept the room header (tester root 141d27f7b - z2000 pointer-events:auto blocked title+pencil taps; fixed); AND (b) ★ the title-tap HANDLER must actually FIRE and open the properties modal on real @390 WebKit - the hit-area covers the visible title, the handler is NOT gated out of the in-room state Tron uses (rb-header.ts:50 title-as-settings-target appears gated on editable/show-edit/isHost via RoomView.ts:165 - ARCHITECT confirms the real gating condition + whether it is host-only or all-members), and it opens ROOM PROPERTIES/SETTINGS = the S19 room-config modal, NOT a different/edit modal (ARCHITECT confirms exactly what 'room properties' resolves to). DEVICE-QA REGRESSION (Tron 2026-07-27, served v0.7.143): the prior QA-Review GREEN was a FALSE-GREEN - it passed in Chromium emulation/logic while the REAL WebKit device shows the title-tap does NOT open properties. My earlier 'title-tap affordance is already wired+correct' assumption was itself REFUTED by the device - layer (b) is a real regression, not merely the banner. Tron verbatim: 'the in-room room properties are a regression... clicking on the room name in-room should open them.' ARCHITECT-CONFIRMED (ec8c789e0): (i) 'room properties' TODAY = the Edit Room Config modal (openRoomEditor RoomView:140 - name/visibility/mode); NO distinct read-only 'properties' view exists. (ii) title-click is HOST-ONLY today (bound only via show-edit rb-header.ts:53, set only when isHost RoomView:165) - non-host tap does nothing. (iii) MECHANICAL ROOT of the non-firing on real @390 iOS = fragile click-on-an-h2; DEFINITE FIX = render the title as a REAL BUTTON (reliable WebKit tap target) - this holds regardless of scope. ★ TRON RULED (2026-07-27 via PO) - LOCKED: (a) tapping the in-room room title opens the EXISTING config/settings modal (openRoomEditor RoomView:140 - NO new view); (b) for ALL in-room members, NOT host-only (remove the show-edit@isHost gating so every member's title-tap opens it); (c) it FIRES on REAL @390 WebKit (real Safari, screenshot-verified - NOT Chromium emulation / NOT DOM-only; that emulation-frame was the false-green root) - via the definite mechanical fix = render the title as a REAL BUTTON (reliable WebKit tap target, replacing the fragile click-on-an-h2); (d) NON-HOST members get a READ-ONLY view of the config, HOST gets EDITABLE (name/visibility/mode) - architect finalizes the read-only-vs-editable rendering. All four LOCKED. ★ TEST-vs-DEVICE SPLIT (PO 2026-07-27): the ENGINE-INDEPENDENT parts - title role=button+tabindex (mechanism), non-host un-gated tap, non-host read-only, server owner-guard reject-non-owner - are chain-complete-to-Test (Test 3e57bca1 r3112b-nonhost-gate.mjs, GREEN DET-3x engine-independent, wired PRIMARY to Impl f9b579c1 RbRoomDetail.editOpen; rb-header T40 39074a59 + server-guard @server.ts:2666 ride-existing note-only). The actual TAP-FIRES-on-real-iOS-WebKit piece is DEVICE-ONLY (Tron device re-confirm, like R30.53 codicon) - NOT a headless-closeable AC (Chromium false-greened the old h2 click). ★ DEVICE-CONFIRMED PASS (Tron 2026-07-27, v0.7.144): "opening the room settings works again" = the real-WebKit tap FIRES -> this device-only OPENING piece PASSED (R30.53-pattern device-credit, NOT pending). T31.12 STAYS In-Progress NOT for tap-fires (passed) but for the NEW host-edit item below (AC-host-edit-saves).

The re-gate MUST run at REAL @390 WebKit (a real device / real Safari, NOT Playwright Chromium emulation and NOT a logic/DOM-only check) for the IN-ROOM flow (chat send/receive + room-title->properties-opens). ★ FALSE-GREEN ROOT (Tron 2026-07-27): the prior gate ran in the WRONG FRAME (Chromium emulation/logic) - it passed GREEN while the real WebKit device FAILED. Acceptance for room-title->properties = a REAL tap on the RENDERED title @390 WebKit OPENS the properties modal, screenshot/pixel-verified (NOT DOM-presence, NOT a synthetic click in emulation). The chat + banner-not-intercept also gate @390. Regression-check: the R31.4/R31.9 drawer wins still hold. Tron device re-confirm. @390 REAL WebKit: the HOST/owner can CHANGE and SAVE room config (name/visibility/mode) and it PERSISTS (server applies UPDATE_ROOM_CONFIG). NEW device-QA item (Tron 2026-07-27 v0.7.144): host OPENS settings but CHANGING does NOT work. PENDING ARCHITECT DIAGNOSIS of which root (PO asking Tron greyed-vs-type-but-Save-noop): (hyp1) isHost resolves FALSE for the owner on device (roomOwnerToken!=playerToken, RoomView:74) -> modal opens READ-ONLY for the owner -> fix the isHost/owner resolution; OR (hyp2) isHost=TRUE but SAVE path broken (Save button same iOS-WebKit fragility as the old h2, or save-handler not wired, or UPDATE_ROOM_CONFIG not applied) -> make Save WebKit-reliable / fix wiring. This AC FINALIZES (testable form) on the architect diagnosis; then expert fix + tester gates REAL @390 WebKit (host edit+save PERSISTS) + Tron re-confirm. Was unreachable before (opening was broken) so possibly pre-existing host-edit bug now EXPOSED, or a regression from the read-only fix. Architect measures.
